_note: Texture slot matching. ORDER IS SIGNIFICANT: each filename is tested against slots top to bottom and the FIRST match wins, so specific slots come before generic ones and 'diffuse' is the last catch-all. This preserves the behaviour tuned in Assets_manager_var01.py (_TEX_SLOTS) and extends it. This table is the binding between files and shader inputs - asset.json records the resolved mapping, so FBX-internal texture paths are never trusted.

matching._udim_patterns: Matched against the stem with its delimiter restored, so the Mari convention 'name.1001.ext' is found. A pattern with TWO groups is the u/v form and the tile is computed as 1001 + (u-1) + (v-1)*10.
matching._udim_range: A four-digit number is only a UDIM tile inside this range. Without it 'brick_2048.png' and 'tex_8192.exr' read as tiles - resolution in a filename is far more common than a tile above 1999.
matching._res_patterns: Resolution and bit-depth tokens, stripped off the stem before anything is matched. Megascans ships ArctiumLappa_Albedo_8bit_2048ppm.png in four sizes; with the tokens left in, those are four DIFFERENT stems, _settle_competing reads them as four maps fighting for the diffuse slot, and three of every four land in extra/. Stripped, they are one map at four sizes. The token is thrown away, never trusted: the resolution that gets recorded is measured from the pixels, because ppm is pixels-per-metre and says nothing certain about the image.
matching._min_slots: A group of images is only promoted to a 'texture' asset when at least this many DISTINCT slots match. One lonely jpg is a 'reference', not a texture set.

slots._variants: Green-channel convention. Detected from the filename when present, otherwise recorded as unknown and flagged in the UI - flipping it wrong is a classic silent bug.
slots._keep: Only the OpenGL normal is stored. DirectX is an exact green-channel inversion, so it is regenerated into derived/ on demand rather than stored. Saves ~150MB per ambientCG asset. If ONLY a DX map is supplied, it is converted to GL at import so the library stays uniform.

slots._note: Legacy gloss maps are inverted roughness. post_node handles it so old libraries import correctly.

Packed maps (game workflow). Poly Haven ships _arm. split_orm unpacks R/G/B into the three slots on import. If an unpacked map for the same slot also exists, the unpacked one wins and the packed map is kept only as a note.
CATCH-ALL, must stay LAST. Otherwise 'subsurface_color' and 'specular_color' get mis-slotted as diffuse.

output_names._note: On import, every texture is RENAMED to <asset>_<output_name>.<ext>. This is the whole point of an owned hierarchy: ambientCG '_Color' and Poly Haven '_diff_' both land as '_basecolor', so adapters and importers never guess again. Guessing happens ONCE, at import.

format_priority._note: When the SAME slot ships in several formats (Poly Haven gives nor_gl as both .exr 133MB and .png 362MB), keep one. Higher index wins. The rejected file is REPORTED, never silently deleted - the user confirms.
format_priority._data_slots: normal/roughness/disp/metallic etc - float precision matters, exr preferred.
format_priority._color_slots: basecolor/emissive/specular - sRGB, jpg acceptable, png preferred.

discard_on_import._note: Vendor-authored files that reference the ORIGINAL filenames and therefore break the moment we rename. We regenerate our own into derived/, so these are dropped rather than rewritten.

_preview_stems: Filenames matching these are treated as the asset preview, never as a texture slot. Matched as a SUBSTRING of the stem, so entries must stay specific: 'asset_100'/'asset_50' are RenderMan .rma bundle previews, and a bare 'asset' would swallow every file a vendor happens to name that way.

preview_rules._bare_stem_is_preview: An image whose stem matches the asset base name with NO slot suffix is the vendor preview render. This is how ambientCG ships it: Concrete014.png next to Concrete014_8K-PNG_Color.png. Without this rule it falls through every slot and lands unmatched.
preview_rules.fallback: If no preview file exists, generate thumb.jpg from the basecolor slot.
